The reversed code has `return` inside the same final success block, which is correct, but because there is no behavior after the switch this is semantically equivalent. If exact branch shape is required, this is a control-flow mismatch only, not an observable behavior mismatch.

- For maximum verifier compliance, preserve the off-grid absolute-value calculation closer to Ghidra’s cast/order form instead of simplifying through named deltas.
